2128: Member names, including edited names, practice, results, performance records, settings and introductory-guide progress are stored on your device so you can continue playing. 2130: A recording is a record of a performance generated by the game. It does not record voices or ambient sound through the microphone. The app does not request access to your camera, microphone, contacts or location.
